column3: NKJV takes several Aramaic words as names of peoples, transliterating “the Apharsathchites” and rendering טַרְפְּלָיֵא אֲפָרְסָיֵא as “the people of Persia”; the meaning of some of these terms is uncertain.
NKJV renders “and it will damage the kings” as “the king’s treasury will be diminished.”
NKJV renders the idiom “we eat the salt of the palace” as “we receive support from the palace.”
